newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One, three-mth Saudi t-bill rates fall, 6-mth up.
newsitem.headline: One, three-mth Saudi t-bill rates fall, 6-mth up.

text.p: Yields on one, three and six-month treasury bills were mixed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering worth three billion riyals, a banker said.
The yield on 28-day bills fell to 5.3332 percent from 5.3585 percent last week, 91-day declined to 5.4360 percent from 5.4598 percent while 182-day rose to 5.54791 percent from 5.4444.
One-month interbank rates were put at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months were at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent and six months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent.
